units: pixels (original 1920x1080 frame) and seconds; no metric scale anywhere

camera.type: handheld, nearly static: slow smooth drift (no pan sweep, no zoom)
camera.drift_frame0_to_74_px: background content moves about +5..+12 px in x and +11..+17 px in y in the image between frame 0 and frame 74 (roll about 0.27 deg, scale change < 0.2%)
camera.per_frame: camera_transforms.json: for each frame a 2x3 similarity matrix a mapping frame-i pixel -> frame-0 pixel; dx,dy = shift of the image centre (frame i -> frame 0)
camera.parallax_check: template-tracked static points (signs, bollard, path arrows, curb) fit the model within 2.3 px; no visible parallax
camera.effect_on_motion: pedestrian moves ~600 px; camera drift changes that by ~1-1.5%. stab_* columns in the tracks are in frame-0 (background-fixed) coordinates

perspective.view: eye-level view looking along a bike path into a roundabout; ground plane recedes upward in the image
perspective.notes: pedestrian walks right-to-left across the far end of the bike path (just in front of the splitter island) and slightly toward the camera: her pixel height grows ~262 -> ~315 px (+20%) and her feet go from y~686 to y~733. The white car drives along the far side of the roundabout (much farther away). The bus is farther still, on the roundabout at right.

pedestrian_summary.reference_point: visible centre = bbox centre (bbox_cx, bbox_cy); mask centroid (cx, cy) and head top (top_x, top_y) also given
pedestrian_summary.occluded_frames: lower legs/feet partly behind the bollard where occluded=1 (frames 34-52; flag = bbox overlaps the bollard column below its top, so it is conservative); bbox_y1 there may be the bollard top, not the feet

white_car_summary.reference_point: mask centroid (cx, cy) and bbox; the car is a side view, nose pointing left
white_car_summary.full_length_frames: bumper-to-bumper bbox_w valid only where the whole car is visible: frames 0-17 (DO NOT ENTER pole crosses the body but the closing bridges it) and 21-28
white_car_summary.notes: frames 18-20 rear end hidden behind the DO NOT ENTER pole (bbox_x1 stuck at ~233); frames 29-59 cut by the left image edge (front end x not measurable; use bbox_x1 = rear bumper)

bus_summary.notes: rear_left_edge_x = left edge of the white rear panel (rear corner); front_end_x = leftmost bus pixel from frame 47 on (side view). Bus is never fully visible; its length cannot be measured.

events.event: pedestrian walking throughout (already moving at frame 0, still moving at frame 74); no start/stop
pedestrian passes behind the bollard (feet partly hidden)
pedestrian head passes the bicycle-sign pole (x~940)
white car rear hidden behind DO NOT ENTER pole
white car front reaches the left image edge
white car fully out of frame
bus rear motion to the right slows to ~0; bus starts turning, side becomes visible
bus front end first detected left of rear (side view)
